sourceAndQuestionComparison: This full26-scene lesson asks why the same rotation angles give different poses when order changes, then defines intrinsic/extrinsic Y-X-Z, fixed-axis ninety-degree examples, canonical Euler ranges and gimbal-lock axes, wrapped one-axis interpolation, radians/endpoints, axis-angle, rotation-vector nonuniqueness/composition limits and angular velocity, ending with two numeric exercises. Flight illustrates orientation rather than franchise identity. Its upcoming quaternion lesson is educational continuation, not a game sequel design proposal. No chapter teaches retaining core gameplay while creating new player decisions or separating development reuse from sequel value.
